en.t: King Æthelstan of England secured the submission of four northern rulers: Constantine II of Scotland, Hywel Dda of Deheubarth, Ealdred I of Bamburgh, and Owain ap Dyfnwal of Strathclyde, leading to seven years of peace
en.s: Æthelstan or Athelstan (; Old English: Æðelstān [ˈæðelstɑːn]; Old Norse: Aðalsteinn; lit. 'noble stone'; c. 894 – 27 October 939) was King of the Anglo-Saxons from 924 to 927 and King of the English from 927 to his death in 939. He was the son of King Edward the Elder and his first wife, Ecgwynn. Modern historians regard him as the first King of England and one of the "greatest Anglo-Saxon kings".

zh.t: 英格兰国王埃塞尔斯坦迫使苏格兰国王君士坦丁二世、德赫巴思的海威尔·达、班堡的埃尔德雷德一世和斯特拉斯克莱德的欧文·阿普·迪夫纳尔四位北方统治者臣服，带来七年和平
zh.s: 埃塞尔斯坦（古英语：Æðelstān [ˈæðelstɑːn]；古诺斯语：Aðalsteinn；意为“高贵之石”；约894年—939年10月27日）于924年至927年担任盎格鲁-撒克逊人的国王，927年至939年去世时担任英格兰国王。他是长者爱德华国王与其第一任妻子埃克温的儿子。现代历史学家将他视为英格兰首位国王，也是“最伟大的盎格鲁-撒克逊国王”之一。

en.s: The siege of Acre was the first significant counterattack by Guy of Jerusalem against Saladin, Sultan of Egypt and Syria. This pivotal siege formed part of what later became known as the Third Crusade. The siege lasted from August 1189 until July 1191, at which time the city's coastal position meant the attacking Latin forces were unable to fully capture the city and Saladin was unable to fully relieve it, with both sides receiving supplies and resources by sea.

en.s: Minamoto no Yoritomo (源 頼朝; Japanese pronunciation: [mʲi.na.mo.to no (|) jo.ɾʲi.to.mo], May 9, 1147 – February 9, 1199) was a samurai, daimyo and the founder and the first shogun of the Kamakura shogunate, ruling from 1192 until 1199, also the first shogun in the history of Japan to hold de-facto power over Japan. He was married to Hōjō Masako, who acted as regent (shikken) after his death.

zh.s: 源赖朝（源 頼朝；日语发音：[mʲi.na.mo.to no (|) jo.ɾʲi.to.mo]；1147年5月9日—1199年2月9日）是武士、大名，也是镰仓幕府的创建者和首任征夷大将军，1192年至1199年在位。他也是日本历史上首位实际掌握日本统治权的征夷大将军。他的妻子北条政子在他去世后担任摄政（执权）。

en.s: The Battle of Sant'Egidio was fought on 12 July 1416 at Sant'Egidio, near Umbertide (central Italy) between the condottiere Braccio da Montone and the troops of Perugia, under Carlo I Malatesta. Braccio's victory resulted in his long-desired conquest of Perugia, of which he became lord. The battle lasted for 7 hours and saw the massive use of heavy cavalry. Braccio used his famous tactics of using repeated cavalry assaults carried on by smaller units, seeking for weak spots in the enemy's line. This also allowed his troops time to refresh, as the battle was fought under an implacable sun.

zh.s: 圣埃吉迪奥战役于1416年7月12日在意大利中部翁贝蒂德附近的圣埃吉迪奥发生，交战双方为雇佣军首领布拉乔·达·蒙托内和卡洛一世·马拉泰斯塔率领的佩鲁贾军队。布拉乔获胜，终于如愿征服佩鲁贾并成为其领主。战斗持续了7小时，大量使用重骑兵。布拉乔采用了著名战术：以较小部队反复发动骑兵冲锋，寻找敌军阵线的薄弱处。这也让他的部队有时间休整；战斗当时正值酷热难耐的烈日之下。

en.t: Hartmann Schedel's Nuremberg Chronicle, one of the best-documented early printed books, is published
en.s: The Nuremberg Chronicle is an illustrated encyclopedia consisting of world historical accounts, as well as accounts told through biblical paraphrase. Subjects include human history in relation to the Bible, illustrated mythological creatures, and the histories of important Christian and secular cities from antiquity. Finished in 1493, it was originally written in Latin by Hartmann Schedel, and a German version was translated by Georg Alt.

zh.s: 《纽伦堡编年史》是一部插图百科全书，包含世界历史叙述以及以圣经故事为基础改写的内容。主题包括与圣经相关的人类历史、神话生物插图，以及古代以来重要基督教和世俗城市的历史。该书于1493年完成，最初由哈特曼·谢德尔用拉丁文撰写，乔治·阿尔特将其译为德文。

en.s: The Battle of Abancay took place during the Spanish conquest of Peru. Alonso de Alvarado, sent by Francisco Pizarro to relieve the siege of Cusco, was camped at Jauja with five hundred men. He guarded the bridge and a ford on the Rio de Abancay, awaiting Almagro's men. However, the soldier Alvarado placed in command of the ford, Pedro de Lerma, deserted, allowing Almagro to capture Alvarado's force almost intact.

en.s: The Battle of Aughrim (Irish: Cath Eachroma) was the decisive battle of the Williamite War in Ireland. It was fought between the Jacobites and the forces of William III on 12 July 1691 (old style, equivalent to 22 July new style), near the village of Aughrim, County Galway. The battle was one of the more bloody recorded fought on Irish soil – over 7,000 people were killed. It meant the effective end of Jacobitism in Ireland, although the city of Limerick held out until the autumn of 1691.

zh.s: 奥格里姆战役（爱尔兰语：Cath Eachroma）是爱尔兰威廉派战争中的决定性战役。1691年7月12日（旧历；相当于新历7月22日），詹姆斯党军队与威廉三世的军队在戈尔韦郡奥格里姆村附近交战。这是爱尔兰本土有记录以来伤亡最惨重的战役之一，死亡人数超过7,000人。战役实际上终结了雅各布派在爱尔兰的势力，但利默里克城仍坚守到1691年秋季。

en.s: Huck's Defeat or the Battle of Williamson's Plantation was one of the first Patriot victories of the southern campaign of the American Revolutionary War. On July 12, 1780, about 250 Patriot militia surprised half their number of Loyalists bivouacked with lax security in York County, South Carolina. Attacked from three sides, the Loyalists were overwhelmed by Patriots seeking revenge for perceived ill treatment, and many were killed without mercy.

zh.s: 哈克惨败又称威廉姆森种植园战役，是美国独立战争南方战役中爱国者阵营最早取得的胜利之一。1780年7月12日，约250名爱国者民兵在南卡罗来纳州约克县突袭了一支正在露营、人数约为己方一半且戒备松懈的保皇派民兵。爱国者从三面进攻，保皇派很快溃败；爱国者因认为对方曾虐待自己而寻求报复，许多人在战斗中被毫不留情地杀死。

en.s: The bombardment of Algiers took place between 12 and 21 July 1784. A joint Spanish-Neapolitan-Maltese-Portuguese fleet commanded by the Spanish Admiral Antonio Barceló bombarded the city, which was the main base of the Barbary corsairs, with the aim of forcing them to interrupt their activities. The second bombardment followed a similarly failed expedition the preceding year.

zh.s: 阿尔及尔炮击发生于1784年7月12日至21日。由西班牙海军上将安东尼奥·巴塞洛指挥的西班牙、那不勒斯、马耳他和葡萄牙联合舰队炮击了阿尔及尔。该城是巴巴里海盗的主要基地，联军希望迫使他们停止活动。这是此前一年一场失败远征后的第二次炮击。

en.s: The Civil Constitution of the Clergy (French: "Constitution civile du clergé") was a law passed on 12 July 1790 during the French Revolution, that subordinated the Roman Catholic Church in France to the French government. It is often stated this law confiscated the Church's French land holdings or banned monastic vows: that had already been accomplished by earlier legislation. It did, however, complete the destruction of the monastic orders, legislating out of existence "all regular and secular chapters for either sex, abbacies and priorships, both regular and in commendam, for either sex", etc.

zh.s: 教士民事组织法（法语：Constitution civile du clergé）是法国大革命期间于1790年7月12日通过的一项法律，将法国的罗马天主教会置于法国政府管辖之下。有人认为该法没收了教会在法国的土地或禁止修道誓愿，但这些措施早已由此前的立法实施。该法确实彻底解散了修会团体，并通过法律废除了“男女修会、男女世俗教士团体、修道院和会院，无论属于修会还是代管性质”等组织。

zh.s: 阿尔赫西拉斯第二次海战又称直布罗陀海峡海战，于1801年7月12日在直布罗陀海峡爆发，交战双方为一支英国皇家海军分舰队和规模更大的西班牙、法国联合舰队。此战属于第二次反法同盟战争期间的阿尔赫西拉斯战役。

en.s: The Fiji Expedition of 1840 was an exploring and surveying expedition, which itself was a part of the wider United States Exploring Expedition (a.k.a. the Wilkes expedition or the U.S. Ex. Ex.) that occurred from May 4 to August 11, 1840. en.s: Elections to Salford Borough Council were held on Friday, 12 July 1844. This was the first local election held in Salford since it had been incorporated under the provisions of the Municipal Corporations Act 1835. As this was the first election to the council, all seats for each of the four wards were up for election. Each ward elected six councillors.

zh.t: 1844年索尔福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 索尔福德自治市议会选举于1844年7月12日（星期五）举行。这是索尔福德依据1835年《市政公司法》设立自治市后举行的首次地方选举。由于这是议会首次选举，四个选区的所有席位都要改选，每个选区选出6名议员。

en.s: The Second Italian War of Independence was fought by the Second French Empire and the Kingdom of Sardinia against the Austrian Empire in 1859 and played a crucial part in the process of Italian Unification. A year prior to the war, in the Plombières Agreement, France agreed to support Sardinia's efforts to expel Austria from Italy in return for territorial compensation in the form of the Duchy of Savoy and the County of Nice.

en.s: The Skirmish at Cedar Lane was a Civil War skirmish fought near Newport News, Virginia on July 12, 1861, as part of the operations on the Virginia Peninsula. The skirmish was the first Civil War combat, and first victory, of future Confederate General John Bell Hood.

en.s: The Medal of Honor (MOH) is the highest military decoration of the United States Armed Forces and is awarded to recognize American soldiers, sailors, marines, airmen, guardians, and coast guardsmen who have distinguished themselves by acts of valor. The medal is normally awarded by the President of the United States (the commander in chief of the armed forces) and is presented "in the name of Congress."

en.s: The Beiyang government (Chinese: 北洋政府; pinyin: Běiyáng Zhèngfǔ; Wade–Giles: Pei-yang Chêng-fu) was the internationally recognized government of the Republic of China between 1912 and 1928, based in Beijing. It was dominated by Yuan Shikai and the other generals of his Beiyang Army, hence the name. After the 1911 Revolution, Sun Yat-sen relinquished the presidency of the Republic of China to Yuan, the most powerful Qing general, in order to secure a peaceful abdication of the Qing court.

zh.t: 第二次革命爆发，李烈钧宣布江西脱离中华民国独立，反抗北洋政府
zh.s: 北洋政府（中文：北洋政府；拼音：Běiyáng Zhèngfǔ；威妥玛拼音：Pei-yang Chêng-fu）是1912年至1928年间国际承认的中华民国政府，首都设在北京。政府由袁世凯及其他北洋军将领主导，因此得名。1911年革命后，孙中山将中华民国总统职位让给清朝最有权势的将领袁世凯，以促成清廷和平退位。

en.s: The Second Revolution (Chinese: 二次革命; pinyin: Èrcì Gémìng) was a failed 1913 revolt by the governors of several southern Chinese provinces and supporters of Sun Yat-sen's Kuomintang (KMT) against the Beiyang government of the Republic of China, led by Yuan Shikai. It was quickly defeated by Yuan's armies and led to the continued consolidation of Yuan's powers as President of the Republic of China.

en.s: The Soviet–Lithuanian Peace Treaty, also known as the Moscow Peace Treaty, was signed between Lithuania and Soviet Russia on July 12, 1920. In exchange for Lithuania's neutrality and permission to move its troops in the territory that was recognised during its war against Poland, Soviet Russia recognized the sovereignty of Lithuania. The treaty was a major milestone in Lithuania's struggle for international recognition and recognised Lithuania's eastern borders.

zh.s: 苏俄—立陶宛和平条约又称《莫斯科和平条约》，于1920年7月12日由立陶宛和苏维埃俄国签署。立陶宛承诺保持中立，并允许苏俄军队在俄方承认的、立陶宛与波兰交战期间获得的领土上调动；作为交换，苏俄承认立陶宛的主权。该条约是立陶宛争取国际承认的重要里程碑，也确认了立陶宛东部边界。

en.s: The 1921 Miami mayoral election took place on July 12, 1921, to elect the mayor of Miami, Florida. This was an off-year election. Incumbent W.P. Smith was not on the ballot. Instead, 10 other candidates vied for seats on the city council, which would lead to the selection of a mayor. The city charter was amended earlier that year to adopt the commission-manager form of government.

en.s: The Battle of Beirut (12 July 1941) marked the end of hostilities in the Syria-Lebanon campaign of World War II. en.s: During World War II, Operation Chestnut was a failed British raid by 2 Special Air Service, conducted in support of the Allied invasion of Sicily. Two teams of ten men each, codenamed 'Pink' and 'Brig', parachuted into northern Sicily on the night of 12 July 1943, to disrupt communications, transport and the enemy in general. All radios were broken and much ammunition, explosives and food were lost in the jump. One team landed near an inhabited area, alerting the defenders. Without radios neither team was able to contact and direct the planes bringing in reinforcements, which subsequently returned to base without any drops being made.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，栗子行动是英国第2特种空勤团为支援盟军入侵西西里岛而实施的一次突袭，但行动失败。1943年7月12日夜间，两支各有10人的小队以“粉红”和“旅”作为代号，空降到西西里岛北部，任务是扰乱通信、交通并打击敌军。所有无线电设备都损坏了，大量弹药、炸药和食品也在跳伞时遗失。一支小队降落在居民区附近，惊动了守军。两队都无法使用无线电联系并引导运送增援部队的飞机，增援机随后空手返回基地。

en.s: The Battle of Prokhorovka was fought on 12 July 1943 near Prokhorovka, 87 kilometres (54 mi) southeast of Kursk, in the Soviet Union, during the Second World War. Taking place on the Eastern Front, the engagement was part of the wider Battle of Kursk and occurred when the 5th Guards Tank Army of the Soviet Red Army attacked the II SS-Panzer Corps of the German Waffen-SS in one of the largest tank battles in history.

en.s: The amphibious Battle of Gela was the opening engagement of the American portion of the Allied Invasion of Sicily during World War II. en.s: Elections for the Japanese House of Councillors were held in Japan on July 12, 1998. The LDP under Ryūtarō Hashimoto had restored single-party government in 1996 and was now aiming to also regain clear control of the House of Councillors where it was several seats short of a majority. Instead, it lost 13 seats in the election giving the opposition clear control. Prime minister Hashimoto resigned. Keizō Obuchi was elected LDP president on July 24, defeating Seiroku Kajiyama and Junichirō Koizumi. On July 30, 1998, Obuchi was designated as prime minister by the Diet against the vote of the House of Councillors where DPJ president Naoto Kan beat Obuchi by 142 to 103 votes.

en.s: On July 12, 2006, Hezbollah militants crossed from Lebanon into Israel and ambushed an Israeli military patrol, killing three soldiers and capturing two. Five more Israeli soldiers were killed in a failed rescue attempt inside Lebanon.

zh.s: 2006年7月12日，真主党武装人员从黎巴嫩越境进入以色列，伏击以军巡逻队，造成3名士兵死亡、2名士兵被俘。另有5名以军士兵在进入黎巴嫩的营救行动中丧生。

en.s: The 2006 Lebanon War, also called the 2006 Israel–Hezbollah War and known in Lebanon as the July War (Arabic: حرب تموز‎‎, Ḥarb Tammūz) and in Israel as the Second Lebanon War (Hebrew: מלחמת לבנון השנייה‎‎, Milhemet Levanon HaShniya), was a 34-day military conflict in Lebanon, Northern Israel and the Golan Heights. The principal parties were Hezbollah paramilitary forces and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). The conflict started on 12 July 2006, and continued until a United Nations-brokered ceasefire went into effect in the morning on 14 August 2006, though it formally ended on 8 September 2006 when Israel lifted its naval blockade of Lebanon.

zh.s: 2006年黎巴嫩战争又称2006年以色列—真主党战争；黎巴嫩称之为“七月战争”（阿拉伯语：حرب تموز，Ḥarb Tammūz），以色列称之为第二次黎巴嫩战争（希伯来语：מלחמת לבנון השנייה，Milhemet Levanon HaShniya）。这场为期34天的军事冲突发生在黎巴嫩、以色列北部和戈兰高地，主要交战方是真主党武装和以色列国防军（IDF）。冲突始于2006年7月12日，联合国斡旋的停火于8月14日上午生效；以色列解除对黎巴嫩的海上封锁后，战争于9月8日正式结束。

en.s: Israeli Special Forces Operations in 2006 were part of the Second Lebanon War. Several commando units of the Israel Defence Forces launched dozens of operations against Hizbullah targets in Lebanon. Most of these were never publicized and many may have consisted of intelligence-gathering probes into Lebanese territory.

en.s: On July 12, 2007, a series of air-to-ground attacks were conducted by a team of two U.S. AH-64 Apache helicopters in Al-Amin al-Thaniyah, New Baghdad, during the Iraqi insurgency which followed the invasion of Iraq. On April 5, 2010, the attacks received worldwide coverage and controversy following the release of 39 minutes of classified gunsight footage by WikiLeaks.

zh.s: 2007年7月12日，在伊拉克入侵后持续的叛乱期间，两架美国AH-64“阿帕奇”直升机组成的机组在新巴格达区的阿明二街区实施了一系列空对地攻击。2010年4月5日，维基解密公布了39分钟的机载瞄准镜机密录像，此后这些攻击受到全球关注并引发争议。

en.s: The Rajnandgaon ambush occurred on 12 July 2009, when at least 29 members of the Indian Police were killed in an ambush attack by Maoist rebels in Rajnandgaon, 90 km (56 mi) from Raipur (India's Chhattisgarh state).The Rajnandgaon ambush is one of the biggest instances of naxal attacks in the state of Chhattisgarh in which 29 Police Personnel including The Superintendent of Police of Rajnadgaon district, Shri Vinod Kumar Chaubey, was martyred. Chaubey was a member of The elite Indian Police Service of 1998 batch. It was the first and only naxal incident in Chhattisgarh till date to have claimed the life of an officer of the Indian Police Service.

zh.s: 2009年7月12日，毛派叛军在拉杰南德冈发动伏击，至少29名印度警察遇害。拉杰南德冈距离印度恰蒂斯加尔邦首府赖布尔90公里（56英里）。这是恰蒂斯加尔邦最严重的纳萨尔派袭击之一，29名殉职警员中包括拉杰南德冈县警察局长维诺德·库马尔·乔贝。他是1998届印度警察服务队成员。这是迄今为止恰蒂斯加尔邦唯一一起造成印度警察服务队官员死亡的纳萨尔派事件。

en.t: Republic of the Congo presidential election, 2009
en.s: A presidential election was held in the Republic of the Congo on 12 July 2009. Long-time President Denis Sassou Nguesso won another seven-year term with a large majority of the vote, but the election was marked by accusations of irregularities and fraud from the opposition; six opposition candidates chose to boycott the election.

zh.s: 刚果共和国于2009年7月12日举行总统选举。长期执政的总统德尼·萨苏-恩格索以明显多数再次当选，获得新的七年任期。反对派指控选举存在违规和舞弊，6名反对派候选人选择抵制选举。

en.s: The 2009 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played on 12 July 2009 at Semple Stadium, Thurles, County Tipperary. It was contested by Tipperary and Waterford. Tipperary claimed their third Munster Championship of the decade, beating Waterford on a scoreline of 4–14 to 2–16, a 4-point winning margin. Overall, this was Tipperary's thirty eighth Munster Senior Hurling Championship.

zh.t: 2009年芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2009年芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛于2009年7月12日在蒂珀雷里郡瑟尔斯的森普尔体育场举行，由蒂珀雷里郡队对阵沃特福德郡队。蒂珀雷里郡队以4比14对2比16获胜，领先4分，赢得该十年里的第三个芒斯特锦标赛冠军。这是蒂珀雷里郡队第38次夺得芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛冠军。

en.s: The Promociones Gutiérrez 1st Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling supercard event promoted by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and Promociones Gutierrez, CMLL's local promoter in Nuevo Laredo, Tamaulipas, Mexico. The event took place on July 12, 2010 at the Plaza de Toros Lauro Luis Longoria bullring and commemorated the 1st anniversary of Promociones Gutierrez. The focal point of the event was a Ruleta de la Muerte (Spanish for "Roulette of Death") tournament, in which five teams of Parejas Incredibles (teams of enemies) participate in an elimination match to see which team would have to face off in a Lucha de Apuestas, mask vs. mask match.

zh.t: 古铁雷斯推广公司一周年纪念赛
zh.s: 古铁雷斯推广公司一周年纪念赛是一场职业摔角特别赛事，由墨西哥摔角委员会（CMLL）及其在墨西哥塔毛利帕斯州新拉雷多的当地推广方古铁雷斯推广公司共同举办。比赛于2010年7月12日在劳罗·路易斯·隆戈里亚斗牛场举行，以纪念该推广公司成立一周年。赛事焦点是“死亡轮盘”锦标赛：5支由宿敌组成的双人组合参加淘汰赛，落败组合将进行一场“赌注战”，对决形式为面具对面具。

en.s: The Battle of Tremseh (Arabic: معركة التريمسة‎‎) was led by the Syrian Army against the Free Syrian Army in Tremseh, Syria, in the late hours of 12 July 2012 during the Syrian Civil War leading to a reported death of dozens of rebels, and an unknown number of civilians. On 14 July 2012, the UN observer mission issued a statement, based on the investigation by its team that went to the town, that the Syrian military mainly targeted the homes of rebels and activists, in what the BBC said was a contradiction of the initial opposition claims of a civilian massacre.

zh.s: 2012年7月12日深夜，叙利亚内战期间，叙利亚军队在叙利亚哈马省特雷姆塞对自由叙利亚军发动进攻。据报道，数十名叛军死亡，平民死亡人数不明。2012年7月14日，联合国观察团发表声明。该团调查小组曾前往当地，声明称叙利亚军方主要袭击叛军和活动人士的住宅。英国广播公司指出，这与反对派最初关于发生平民大屠杀的说法相矛盾。

en.s: On 12 July 2013, a train crash occurred in the commune of Brétigny-sur-Orge in the southern suburbs of Paris, France, when a passenger train carrying 385 people derailed and hit the station platform. Seven people were killed and nearly 200 were injured. The accident was cited as the most serious rail crash in France since the 1988 Gare de Lyon accident in which 56 people were killed.

zh.t: 布雷蒂尼-叙尔-奥尔日列车事故
zh.s: 2013年7月12日，一列客运列车在法国巴黎南郊的布雷蒂尼-叙尔-奥尔日公社发生脱轨，并撞上车站月台。列车上有385人，事故造成7人死亡、近200人受伤。这起事故被认为是法国自1988年里昂火车站事故（造成56人死亡）以来最严重的铁路事故。

The match was held on 12 July 2015 at the Petrovsky Stadium, in Saint Petersburg.

zh.s: 2015年俄罗斯足球超级杯（俄语：Суперкубок России по футболу）是该赛事第13场比赛，对阵双方为2014—15赛季俄罗斯超级联赛冠军圣彼得堡泽尼特队和2014—15赛季俄罗斯杯冠军莫斯科火车头队。比赛于2015年7月12日在圣彼得堡的彼得罗夫斯基体育场举行。

en.s: The 2015 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match which was played on 12 July 2015 at Semple Stadium, Thurles. The winners would advance to the semi-finals of the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, with the loser going into the All-Ireland quarter-finals. Tipperary and Waterford contested the final, with Tipperary winning the title on a 0-21 to 0-16 scoreline.

zh.t: 2015年芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2015年芒斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛于2015年7月12日在瑟尔斯的森普尔体育场举行。获胜队将晋级全爱尔兰高级锦标赛半决赛，失利队则进入全爱尔兰四分之一决赛。决赛由蒂珀雷里郡队对阵沃特福德郡队，蒂珀雷里郡队以0比21对0比16获胜。

en.s: The Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM) presidential primaries, 2015 took place in July 2015 to determine CCM's nominee for the Presidency of Tanzania for the 2015 election. zh.t: 林肯红魔队1比0击败凯尔特人队

zh.s: 2016年“目的地X”（又称“Impact摔角：目的地X”）是全面不间断摔角（TNA）举办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2016年7月12日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Zone举行。这是“目的地X”系列的第12场赛事，并作为TNA每周节目《Impact摔角》的一期特别直播节目播出。

zh.s: 土耳其于2018年7月12日举行议会议长选举，选出大国民议会第28任议长，任期为土耳其第27届议会的前三年。第27届议会中有7个政党，因此外界预计议长将在第三轮投票中选出，因为没有政党或选举联盟拥有直接选出候选人所需的三分之二多数。

en.s: The 2025 Great American Bash, also promoted as The Great American Bash: Atlanta, was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's developmental brand, NXT. It was the 13th Great American Bash under the WWE banner, the sixth annual produced specifically for NXT, and the 27th Great American Bash event overall.
